title: Assign roster archetypes on join
description: When a player joins, the server assigns a faction-appropriate archetype name (Questioners/Educators) and includes it in GAME_STATE and PLAYER_JOINED payloads so clients can display it.
steps: Define a roster list for each faction (generic parody names) and pick one at join
Store the chosen archetype on the player record and include it in join/state payloads
Ensure reconnecting clients receive archetypes for existing players

title: Render labels for remote players
description: Remote players show a label above their sprite with the roster archetype name (fallback to faction if missing) and labels are cleaned up on leave.
steps: Create a text label when a remote player is created and keep it anchored above the sprite
Update label text/tint when roster or faction changes
Destroy labels when the remote player is removed

title: Add battle line text and player counts
description: Show a small UI readout near the battle line bar with the current percentage and faction counts from ROUND_STATE.
steps: Add text elements for battle line percent and faction counts
Update the text when ROUND_STATE arrives
Keep the text aligned when the canvas resizes

title: Show a round end banner
description: When the server sends ROUND_END, display a brief banner announcing the winning faction before fading away.
steps: Listen for ROUND_END and map the winner to a display label
Show a centered banner with faction color and text for a short duration
Hide and reset the banner so it can be reused
